prompt: Which follow-up should Ivo make about the hose reel?
promptZh: 伊沃應如何處理水管捲盤的後續事宜？

options.text: Send the treasurer a photo of the reel and of the loose tag beside it.
options.zh: 把捲盤和旁邊掉落標牌的照片寄給財務負責人。
options.whyZh: 捲盤已無法使用，的確需要拍照。但旁邊的方形牌是從水箱支架上掉下來的，不能拿來判斷捲盤歸屬。

options.text: Photograph the reel with its own tag and send the images to the association's caretaker.
options.zh: 拍下捲盤及它本身的標牌，並將照片寄給住宅協會的管理員。
options.whyZh: 捲盤無法恢復使用；捲盤原有標牌與戶外水龍頭組的一樣，都是圓形。公告要求拍下捲盤本身和它自己的牌，寄給住宅協會管理員，即使設備在圍欄內也一樣。

options.text: Wait and report the reel only if the outside tap stops working again.
options.zh: 先等一等，只有戶外水龍頭再次故障時才通報捲盤。
options.whyZh: 水龍頭還能裝水，不妨礙現在通報捲盤。公告是依各設備能否恢復使用來處理，並未要求關聯設備同時故障。

options.text: Photograph the reel and its own tag, but send the images to the treasurer because the reel is inside the fence.
options.zh: 拍下捲盤和它本身的標牌，但因捲盤在圍欄內，將照片寄給財務負責人。
options.whyZh: 拍攝捲盤和它的標牌是對的，但牌的形狀才決定收件方。捲盤的圓形牌代表住宅協會的設備，圍欄內的位置不會改變這項規則。

explanationZh: 捲盤無法恢復使用；捲盤原有標牌與戶外水龍頭組的一樣，都是圓形。公告要求拍下捲盤本身和它自己的牌，寄給住宅協會管理員，即使設備在圍欄內也一樣。

vocabulary.note: 修飾的是設備本身的標牌，不包括旁邊掉落的牌。

evidence: If a damaged fixture cannot be put back into service, photograph both the fixture and the tag fixed to it. A square tag identifies committee property: the treasurer needs the photos before approving a replacement. A round tag identifies a fixture lent by the housing association: send the photos to its caretaker, even if the fixture stands inside our fence. / Ivo: Before I forget, the water-tank stand and the outside tap assembly both tipped over. I took pictures of each with its tag. The stand is back in place, and we filled two cans from the tap after I straightened it. But the crank in the hose reel sheared off; there’s no way to wind it up now. / The loose square tag by the hose reel came off the water-tank stand when it tipped. The reel still has its own tag on the back; it’s the same shape as the tag on the outside tap assembly. The tap’s tag is round, and the assembly appears on the association’s loan list.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If a damaged fixture cannot be put back into service, photograph both the fixture and the tag fixed to it. A square tag identifies committee property: the treasurer needs the photos before approving a replacement. A round tag identifies a fixture lent by the housing association: send the photos to its caretaker, even if the fixture stands inside our fence.

Ivo: Before I forget, the water-tank stand and the outside tap assembly both tipped over. I took pictures of each with its tag. The stand is back in place, and we filled two cans from the tap after I straightened it. But the crank in the hose reel sheared off; there’s no way to wind it up now.

The loose square tag by the hose reel came off the water-tank stand when it tipped. The reel still has its own tag on the back; it’s the same shape as the tag on the outside tap assembly. The tap’s tag is round, and the assembly appears on the association’s loan list.
